archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for Premium Corporate / Luxury (Light Theme)
emotional_tone: Premium, authoritative, clean, sophisticated, and trusted.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-light or font-medium text-slate-900

rules: NO default SaaS blue. Use Slate (#0F172A) combined with subtle Gold/Champagne (#C5A059) for premium accents.
Gradients must be extremely soft, almost imperceptible 'mesh' style (white to slate-50).
Always set hover text color explicitly.

layout_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy - Use 2-3x more spacing. Containers with borders must have p-6 or p-8.

bento_grid_categories.description: Asymmetrical 9-card bento grid for the 9 Categories to look premium rather than basic 3x3.

cards.style: Glassmorphism or ultra-subtle Neumorphism. 1px delicate inner stroke (border-slate-200), soft ambient shadow (shadow-sm). For images, do not use heavy overlays.

header.style: Crystal Glass. backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px bottom border border-slate-100. Sticky positioning with z-50.

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-none or very slight rounding (rounded-sm). Minimalist premium.
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-400 rounded-sm.

forms.strategy: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Heavily strip the 'Vercel-look'. Make inputs feel like premium editorial forms (e.g., bottom-border only, or very light gray bg with no border until focus).

trust_section.strategy: The 'Editorial Ribbon' Marquee. Use react-fast-marquee. Serif or clean Sans, small text (text-sm), massive gaps (gap-24). Warm/Pale background.

interactions_and_motion.hero: Slow zoom on hero background images. Staggered fade-up for hero text (H1, Subtitle, CTA).
interactions_and_motion.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling if possible. Elements should fade in gently with subtle upward translation on enter viewport.
interactions_and_motion.hover: Image cards should slightly scale up their inner image (scale-105) while the container stays fixed.

pages_to_build: Homepage (Hero motion banner, Trust Ribbon, 9 Categories Bento Grid, 5-Step Process, CTA)
Product Detail (Gallery, info, MOQ, Enquire CTA)

media.icons: lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react (Phosophor preferred for premium look)

hero_backgrounds.description: Luxury hamper with wine and food

testing.data_testid_rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the Layout with an overarching <main> that uses light premium background.

For the Hero Section, create a staggered text entrance with Framer Motion, and a subtle automatic image crossfade (motion banner) in the background. Ensure text is highly readable by using a soft gradient overlay (bg-white/40 with backdrop-blur-sm if needed, or pure white with strong contrast text).
Build the 9 Categories section exactly using the specified BENTO GRID logic for spans to prevent it from looking like a standard boring grid.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for marketing layouts (Hero, Bento Grid), and Shadcn for Interactive logic (Forms, Modals).
